title: Discovery response analogue with shortened domain-specific item name
purpose: Provide a standalone server-to-client style discovery response analogue that contains a very short visible name component, supporting mutation toward issue-599 style fixed-offset assumptions on returned item identifiers.
expected_behavior: A client-side parser may accept the compact response shape and then process an unusually short name field. Further mutation of the visible-string length and contents can probe assumptions about internal name layout and suffix expectations.
constraints_preserved: tpkt total length matches full frame
single standalone response remains recognizable as mms-like over rfc1006
short field is an analogue not a direct reproduced patched packet
issue_safety_notes: This is a safe structural analogue for the shortened itemId condition and does not reproduce an exact intercepted or patched GetNamedVariableListAttributesResponse from the report.
